method_card.objective: Search reviewed S288C yeast hydrolysis annotations and sequence homologs for trehalose or sucrose.
method_card.mechanism: Use one gx.yeast-enzyme-scope/1 material (taxid 559292). Set substrate to trehalose or sucrose. Search Rhea, Swiss-Prot and ENZYME. BLASTp searches the old 6,733-member Swiss-Prot S288C database.
method_card.estimator: Unique accession, row-level reaction direction, experimental-paper pointers, class-only links, sequences grouped by similarity; raw BLAST HSPs and coverage.
method_card.training_data_lineage: Database annotations and sequences. No trained model.

manifest.licence: GX release source; database terms apply to data.
manifest.licence_basis: UniProt CC BY 4.0, Rhea CC BY 4.0, SIB ENZYME terms.
manifest.limitations: Only reviewed yeast S288C and the two named sugar hydrolysis queries. Database and homology evidence cannot establish activity or direction on their own.
